49ers LT Trent Williams, listed as questionable for today’s game vs. the Cowboys due to an ankle injury, is expected to play, per source. https://t.co/0Yb0j9aTAQ
#Panthers edge Jaelan Phillips, who has been out since mid-October with a hamstring injury, is expected to play today, source said. He’s listed as questionable.
Anthony not expected to need surgery: 'Rest is likely the best path to recovery'

#Jets WR Garrett Wilson (concussion) cleared the NFL’s concussion protocol and will play today. Meanwhile, WR Omar Cooper Jr. (ankle) and AD Mitchell (knee) are both expected to go after being listed as questionable.

#Vikings WR Jordan Addison, who suffered a thumb injury in practice on Friday and is questionable, will have his status determined closed to game-time. But there is some doubt, as MIN elevated WR Jeshaun Jones as insurance.
#Texans star edge Will Anderson Jr., who is questionable after missing practice this week with an ankle injury, is expected to play.
#Lions WR Amon-Ra St. Brown (ribs) is listed as questionable and expected to play in Detroit’s game in Germany.
#Cowboys CBs Daron Bland (ankle) and CB Joey Porter Jr. (ankle/foot) both are questionable and both are trending towards playing, sources say. Porter has had two good practices in two days.
Patriots WR A.J. Brown and RB Rhamondre Stevenson, both listed as questionable for this morning’s game in Munich Germany, both are expected to play, per sources. https://t.co/jngrrGDLiE
Chiefs say Chris Jones now has rejoined the team in Atlanta and he is expected to play Sunday vs. the Falcons.
Chargers are listing WR Ladd McConkey as questionable for Monday night’s game at Baltimore while WR Tre Harris is off the injury report.
Saints activated RB Travis Etienne off injured reserve, and he is expected to play Sunday against Carolina. https://t.co/iBJnY9R2xF

#Texans RB David Montgomery (groin) and CB Jaylin Smith (hamstring) will not travel with the team to Cleveland and have been ruled out vs the #Browns. OT Braden Smith now is questionable with an illness.
Texans ruled out RB David Montgomery for Sunday’s game at Cleveland due to a groin injury.
More about the Chiefs downgrading RB Kenneth Walker to out and turning to rookie RB Emmett Johnson: https://t.co/kC9TZKYrjF
Steelers added TE Pat Freiermuth (to the injury report and he is questionable for Sunday night’s game against Cincinnati’s due to an illness.

Chiefs are going to hold out RB Kenneth Walker for Sunday’s game at Atlanta after he injured his groin during Thursday’s practice, per source. The Chiefs, in the words of a source, “want to give him a week.” https://t.co/aA54MxDIpd
#Chiefs RB Kenneth Walker is not expected to play this week, source says. Too quick of a turnaround. https://t.co/TV8fH5kZse

The first time the Vikings reached out to the Raiders about a potential trade for Kirk Cousinswas mid-day Monday, hours before Minnesota played the Bills on “Monday Night Football.” Trade notebook via @RapSheet and me. https://t.co/9Gmgmsq7wE

As it turns out, Ravens QB Lamar Jackson underwent thumb surgery last week, per sources. If the 6-10 week injury window that Ravens HC Jesse Minter is applied to last week’s surgery, it would give Jackson a chance at returning later this season.
